The Hollow Keep

## The Keeper

Keeper Sarn guards the Hollow Keep. The Silver Key is hidden in the Hall of Embers. Keeper Sarn keeps the Bronze Key in the Deep Well.

Keeper Sarn stands watch beside the Iron Gate every night.

## The Garden of Ash

The Garden of Ash lies beyond the Iron Gate. The Deep Well stands at the center of the Garden of Ash.

The Silver Key opens the Iron Gate. The Bronze Key opens the Deep Well. The traveller carries the Lantern of Dawn through the Garden of Ash.

## The Traveller

The traveller enters the Hollow Keep at dusk. The traveller rests in the Hall of Embers before dawn.
